title: OptionEod
description: obs.option_eod r1: one option contract on one session day, frozen after the close.

capture_id.description: Identifier of the capture, a uuid.

generation.description: Generation of the instrument terms the capture used.

market_data_type.description: Broker market data type: 1 live, 2 frozen, 3 delayed, 4 delayed frozen.

received_at.description: Instant the capture was received, UTC.

event_ts.description: Instant of the quote at the venue, UTC; null when unknown.

status.description: Status of the row: 1 ok, 2 no quote, 3 not listed, 4 stale, 5 error.

error_code.description: Error code of the broker or the capture; null when none.

currency.description: Currency of the prices, three upper-case letters.

snapshot_kind.description: Kind of the snapshot, for example eod.

terms_version_id.description: Version of the contract terms; null when unknown.

last.description: Last trade price. Null when absent.

volume.description: Volume of the day. Null when absent.

oi_asof_date.description: Date the open interest refers to; null when absent.

underlying_price.description: Price of the underlying at the capture. Null when absent.

underlying_ccy.description: Currency of the underlying, three upper-case letters.

underlying_event_ts.description: Instant of the underlying quote, UTC; null when unknown.

iv_bid_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_mid_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_ask_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

delta.description: Delta. Null when absent; the writer turns -1 into null.

gamma.description: Gamma. Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

theta_per_calendar_day.description: Theta per calendar day. Null when absent; the writer turns -1 into null.

vega_per_vol_point.description: Vega per volatility point. Null when absent; -1 is not a value.
